thread.title: Web scraping with R: Scrape (headquarter) location of (subordinate) companies

author: Jonathan
title: Web scraping with R: Scrape (headquarter) location of (subordinate) companies
text:
up vote -1 down vote favorite 
At the moment, I possess a dataset which consists of 1150 firms (firm name) and based on the ticker symbols/firm names, I would like to grab and scrape the location of the subordinate companies of these firms with the help of a specific webpage. 
The location data can be found here by filling in the Ticker Symbols in ''Fast Search'': 
https://www.sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/companysearch.html 
Exhibit 21 of Form 10-K provides a detailed list of the names and locations of a firm's significant subsidiaries across the country and around the world. 
So, for example: on the website under 'Fast Search' you fill in 'AAPL' for the company Apple and then you get redirected to the search results. In the search results you would like to filter ''Filing Type'' on Form 10-K. Based on the filing I would like to get the most recent filing type for exhibit 21. 
For Apple this would be: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019317000070/0000320193-17-000070-index.htm 
And then Exhibit 21.1: 
This shows not only the subsidiaries but also the location. 
What are the most efficient ways to do this in R ?
